lines.zh: 我慢悠悠地踱，不急着去哪。
lines.en: I pace along slowly, in no hurry to be anywhere.

lines.zh: 长戟拖着，刃在草上划出沟。
lines.en: My halberd drags, grooving the grass.

lines.zh: 甲片哗啦一响，我又迈了一步。
lines.en: My plates clatter and I take another step.

lines.zh: 我把木门推开，木屑飞起来。
lines.en: I push the wooden door open and splinters fly.

lines.zh: 前头有动静，我加快了半拍。
lines.en: Something up ahead; I pick up half a beat.
I walk the treeline, counting trunks.

lines.zh: 靴子陷进泥里，我拔出来。
lines.en: My boot sinks in mud and I pull it free.

lines.zh: 队伍在我身后，我不能走太快。
lines.en: The file's behind me; I can't go too fast.

lines.zh: 我绕过大石，稍侧了侧甲。
lines.en: I round the big rock, angling my plate.
The halberd tip rides low, ready to lift.
My steps aren't heavy, but they're sure.
I stop, listen it out, then walk on.

lines.zh: 甲上的布条被风吹到脸上。
lines.en: A scrap of cloth on my armour blows into my face.
I patrol along the riverbank.

lines.zh: 前面有岔路，我选了左边。
lines.en: A fork ahead; I take the left.
I glance back at the end of the file.
I lean on a tree without letting go of the halberd.

lines.zh: 头盔里传出很轻的呼吸。
lines.en: Very light breathing comes from my helm.
I slowly rotate the halberd shaft.
Birds in the wood; I don't move.

lines.zh: 旗往哪边飘，我就往哪站
lines.en: I stand where the banner points.
A leaf has landed on my plate.
I shift my weight to the other foot.
I'm waiting for the order from up front.
The water sounds steady far off.

lines.zh: 我把戟靠在肩窝里歇着。
lines.en: I rest the halberd in the crook of my shoulder.

lines.zh: 面甲下面的空气有点闷。
lines.en: The air under my visor is close.

lines.zh: 我听着自己的甲片轻响。
lines.en: I listen to my own plates ticking.
Not too close; the halberd is long.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，面甲反着光。
lines.en: I raise my eyes; my visor catches the light.
Walking the night road alone — bold.
Your hands are empty.
I lower the halberd tip and clear the way.
Where does this road lead?
I stand and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的鞋上沾着别的林子里的土。
lines.en: There's soil on your boots from another wood.

lines.zh: 你的目光在找我的破绽
lines.en: Your eyes are hunting my weak point.
Say your piece and I'll be on my way.
I stumble half a step and catch a tree.
A plate's dented; I suck in a breath.
Blood comes through the seams.
I turn, halberd still in hand.

lines.zh: 我踩空半步，甲片哗啦响
lines.en: I miss half a step; my plates clatter.
I don't shout; I just stand firm.

lines.zh: 面甲里全是自己的喘气
lines.en: My own panting fills the visor.
I push my visor up a little.
The line's intact; I take my place.
I can carry this much.
Supplies? On the ground.
I can't get the visor off.
I'll put this on the ledger.
Where did you get this?
Not for me; we're short of water.
It passes well enough.
I eat standing, not sitting.
I don't like you at my back.
Hold the halberd a moment.
Then go; don't linger.
You hit me and I stagger.
Armour is heavy; I turn slowly.
I lift the halberd to block.
Half a step aside is enough.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的甲片错开了。
lines.en: That knock shifted my plates out of line.
That knock numbed my shin plate.
I steady myself and straighten up.

lines.zh: 你的肩顶到了我的臂甲
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked my arm plate.
I step back so you can go first.
My armour's rattling; I'm setting it right.

lines.zh: 我记得以前不需要穿甲。
lines.en: I remember a time before the armour.

lines.zh: 我把头盔摘下来放在膝上。
lines.en: I take off my helm and rest it on my knee.
Wind on my face feels good.

lines.zh: 同袍守着，我能睡一会儿。
lines.en: Comrades on watch, so I can sleep a while.
The night isn't long.
I reach out and don't touch.
I keep the plate on tonight. Leave it.
I haven't forgotten my name.

lines.zh: 有人在旁边，甲就没那么冷。
lines.en: With someone nearby the plate feels less cold.
I lay the halberd between us.
I bend and pick it up.
A clasp, fallen from armour.
I use the halberd tip instead of bending.
This should be handed in.
Everything picked up goes on the ledger.
Too shattered to pick up.
I pull the broken arrow out and keep it.
Armoured hands fumble; I drop it once.
I stand it against a tree root.
Whosever it is, come claim it.
Something over there — not a person.
I bring the halberd up to shoulder height.
The file closes; I take the flank.
I'll watch it a few steps first.
Under the plate I hold my breath.
If it comes, I set the shaft across.
Steps quiet, I slide toward it.
I've chosen its legs.

lines.zh: 这一带有平民，不能放它过去。
lines.en: There are civilians here; it can't get past.
I raise a hand for the file to halt.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕，戟一直指着它。
lines.en: I circle slowly with the halberd on it.
It wants my flank.
I give half a step to make room.
It moved; so did I.
The plate will hold against its teeth.
I'm counting its footfalls.
It tires faster than I do.
I tighten my grip on the shaft.
When it turns, I move in.
I'll hold this road until dawn.
A sweep of the shaft shoves it back.
The tip goes in deep.
I drive the shaft into its chest.
A pauldron charge knocks it crooked.
Not heavy, but well placed.
It hits the plate and rebounds.
I switch hands and strike again.
It backs to a tree and I press in.
I lay the halberd across its throat.
I hold my ground and don't chase.

lines.zh: 我一步踏出来，甲片还在响。
lines.en: I step out with my plates still ringing.
The helm clicks shut and the world goes muffled.
I pull the halberd from the soil.
A stand of trees ahead, very quiet.
The file falls in behind me.
I check the ground, then the treeline.

lines.zh: 甲有点松，我紧了紧带子。
lines.en: My plate's loose; I cinch the strap.
Not yet dawn — good for patrol.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有东西在走。
lines.en: I hear something walking far off.
I take my first step forward.
The iron is hot enough to burn.
The armour takes me down, heavy as stone.
Water pours in at my collar.
The blast flips me inside my own armour.
The arrowhead through the plate, into my shoulder.
A spell went around the armour.
Too long unfed; I can barely lift the halberd.

lines.zh: 雷沿着甲走，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning runs the plate and I shudder.
The ground's gone and the armour falls faster.
